name: What preparation is needed before starting an interior renovation project?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before starting an interior renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before commencing an interior renovation, homeowners should gather inspiration, define their functional needs for the space, and establish a realistic budget. It is helpful to consider your long-term goals for your home, including lifestyle changes and desired aesthetic. During our initial consultation, we discuss these aspects to align your vision with our design and construction capabilities. Having a clear understanding of your priorities will enable AKN Design Group to develop a customized plan that effectively enhances functionality, beauty, and long-term value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prior to renovation, gather inspiration, define functional needs, and establish a budget. A clear understanding of your goals helps us customize your project.
